nodes.label: Google Business Profile claim and category audit
nodes.rationale: index.html's Organization schema carried a share.google short link instead of the canonical Maps place URL, flagged as the single highest-impact local-SEO blocker; the canonical cid URL was substituted once the owner supplied it, but the primary/secondary GBP category audit (Choir/Music Service, plus Wedding Service and Funeral Service) still needs a human in the dashboard.

nodes.label: Third-party citation building (Bark, Hitched, Bridebook, FuneralGuide, Yell)
nodes.rationale: Google cross-references third-party citation sources for local rankings; NAP (name/address/phone) consistency across all of them is load-bearing because format variants split the local-SEO citation graph. Draft copy lives in docs/off-site-listings-pack.md.

nodes.label: Post-event review request workflow (Google + Trustpilot)
nodes.rationale: Goal: 30+ Google + Trustpilot reviews in 90 days via a day-30/day-60/day-90 email cadence, since review velocity (not absolute count) shifts local-pack ranking. No incentivised reviews, per Google/Trustpilot policy.

nodes.label: GSC, GA4, and CrUX credentials provisioning
nodes.rationale: A Google Cloud service-account with resource-level read access to Search Console and GA4, plus a separate restricted API key for the Chrome UX Report API, are required before Phase 3 performance/analytics queries in SEO-AUDIT-2026-05-08.md §9 can run.

nodes.label: Fastly/host-level response header changes (deferred)
nodes.rationale: CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS preload, extensionless-URL redirects, and Cache-Control cannot be set on stock GitHub Pages; deferred until a host migration or a Fastly/Cloudflare Workers edge layer is added, revisited only if real CWV/security data justifies it.

nodes.label: Per-page OG image generation infrastructure
nodes.rationale: The site originally shared one generic OG image across every page; six branded 1200x630 images were generated for the 7 money pages and 57 music guides (category-mapped), but area pages and a dedicated logo asset are still outstanding.

nodes.label: IndexNow protocol implementation
nodes.rationale: Bing's index feeds ChatGPT browsing and other assistants' search grounding, so fast Bing pickup via IndexNow is the cheapest direct route into AI-assistant answers; the key file and scripts/indexnow-ping.py plus .github/workflows/indexnow.yml automate the ping on every Pages deploy.

nodes.label: CSS extraction refactor (deferred decision)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately skipped: pages already have decent Core Web Vitals at ~60-70KB pre-gzip, so the caching benefit of extracting inline CSS into external stylesheets is judged small; revisit only if real CrUX field data shows LCP>2.5s tied to render-blocking CSS.

nodes.label: Christmas season human follow-ups (GBP seasonal posts, Ads conversions, recordings)
nodes.rationale: The July 2026 Christmas expansion added 12 pages targeting carol-service and carol-singer hirers; human-only follow-ups include GBP seasonal updates linking to christmas.html and carol-singers.html, per-source Google Ads conversion actions, and recording actual carol performance video (one recording, Blue Christmas/mKMjUvCCW3E, is already wired with VideoObject schema).

nodes.label: Google Ads campaigns for competitive capture programme
nodes.rationale: Five campaign lines target funerals.html and compare/london-funeral-singers.html; competitor brand terms may be used as keywords but never in ad creative text, per Google Ads trademark policy, to avoid the mark-holder's complaint.

nodes.label: SERP baseline measurement, 2026-08-19/20/21
nodes.rationale: The site is absent from head-term SERPs for 'funeral singers London hire', 'wedding choir hire London', and 'hire carol singers London office Christmas' — dominated by marketplaces (Poptop, Encore) and competitors (The London Funeral Singers, londonweddingchoir.com, londoncarolsingers.com). Brand-plus-service queries do surface site pages and an AI answer-layer summary, though it echoed a stale pre-rise £215 soloist price.

nodes.label: Private events page launch follow-ups, 2026-08-26
nodes.rationale: private-events.html shipped typographic-only pending photography, a fuller vetted venue list, and voicing demo videos gated through data/seo-fix-discovered-urls.yml verification before insertion.

nodes.label: Destination weddings programme follow-ups, 2026-08-29
nodes.rationale: Ireland and Scotland region lists were set provisionally pending owner confirmation; US paid-performance visa lead time must be verified as a hard constraint before that page overpromises; repo graph refresh done 2026-09-04 against commit 378f8d8, going from 911/1490 to 1082/2169 nodes/edges.

nodes.label: www subdomain broken TLS certificate, 2026-08-30
nodes.rationale: www.londonchoralservice.com fails the TLS handshake because the repo's CNAME only declares the apex domain, so GitHub Pages never provisions a certificate covering www; fix requires adding www as an alternate custom domain in repo Settings, a dashboard action outside the repo.

nodes.label: Re-anchor Google Business Profile to London, 2026-09-03
nodes.rationale: index.html's LocalBusiness schema already gives a London address (N1 7GU) but the live GBP listing is anchored 'Maidenhead'; the Barbershop Grams launch needs 'barbershop quartet London' local-pack visibility, so the two must be reconciled via a dashboard edit (staffed address vs. service-area business).

nodes.label: Barbershop Grams launch — owner actions, 2026-09-03
nodes.rationale: A filmed barbershop demo is the critical path: the comparison page compare/barbershopogram.html and the hub page's proof-of-sound both depend on it, since linking a gift buyer to listen.html would land them on funeral repertoire (the register-collision the mini-site architecture exists to prevent). Repertoire list confirmed 2026-09-04; OG image done 2026-09-04.
